title: HKMA and Swift deepen tokenized-deposit interoperability work under Project Ensemble
why_it_matters: The proposed connection would link Hong Kong's domestic tokenization infrastructure with Swift's international banking network, addressing a practical barrier to moving regulated digital deposits across jurisdictions. It remains an exploration rather than a newly launched cross-border payment service.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

HKMA and Swift deepen tokenized-deposit interoperability work under Project Ensemble

Hong Kong's monetary authority and Swift are examining how Swift's ledger could connect with Project Ensemble's settlement layer for cross-border payments using tokenized deposits in multiple currencies.
